latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at ebcf1153a5480df8ce1da19fe9324baf668ac595 -->

## What's Changed
### Enhancements
* Force-include wakes-reforged for Better MC [FORGE] BMC4 by @denizkoekden in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4373
* Add USE_MEOWICE_ZGC_FLAGS to use the ZGC version of MeowIce's flags by @spa77k in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4382
* pumpkin: Alpine/musl is no longer supported upstream by @itzg in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4384
* Force-include SDM UI Lib and GeckolibBetterFPS for CurseForge packs by @Wroud in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4385
### Documentation
* example: po3 from local zip file with cleanroom loader by @kman3107 in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4366
* build(deps): bump the patches group in /docs with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4368
* build(deps): bump python-dateutil from 2.9.0.post0 to 3.0.0 in /docs by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4369
* Update MASH documentation links by @spatterIight in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4374
* build(deps): bump the patches group in /docs with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4376
* Document actual defaults of REMOVE_OLD_MODS_INCLUDE and REMOVE_OLD_MODS_DEPTH by @spa77k in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4375
### Other Changes
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.74.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4365
* build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.7.0 in the updates group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4367
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.74.4 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4370
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.75.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4371
* Split log4j and JVM flags handling out of start-finalExec by @spa77k in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4372
* Update dependency itzg/mc-image-helper to v1.76.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4381
* Update all non-major dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4383

## New Contributors
* @spa77k made their first contribution in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4372
* @denizkoekden made their first contribution in https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/pull/4373

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/itzg/docker-minecraft-server/compare/2026.10.1...2026.11.0
